basic_info.description: Built in 1907, this stately full-floor Victorian condo is nestled on one of San Francisco's most private picturesque streets - Piedmont St. The home's architectural beauty and timeless appeal are apparent from the moment you first see the building. With 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 updated bathrooms, a flexible floor plan, and dedicated 1-car parking, this condo epitomizes San Francisco living. Located in a charming 2-unit building, this flat beautifully blends historic character with contemporary upgrades. Original Victorian details have been lovingly preserved, while the remodeled kitchen and primary bath bring modern convenience and style. The sunlit kitchen, with western exposure, opens directly to a private deck perfect for morning coffee or evening gatherings. Tucked away on tranquil Piedmont Street, this home offers a peaceful retreat just moments from the vibrant energy of Cole Valley, the Haight-Ashbury district, Buena Vista Park, and scenic Corona Heights. Whether you're seeking serenity or city excitement, this location delivers the best of both worlds. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history in one of its most coveted neighborhoods.
